headline: Profitability remains strong with RoE sustaining at 20%, but asset quality deteriorates

highlights: While an ARC sale of INR 0.88bn optically compressed the GNPL ratio to 1.68% in Q2FY27, credit cost remained elevated for the second consecutive quarter at 69bps, prompting management to revise its credit cost guidance upward to 55-60bps vs. 50bps earlier.
Considering likely ~20% RoE/AUM growth in FY27E and inexpensive valuation, we maintain BUY, with a revised TP of INR 250 (earlier INR 305), valuing the stock at 2x (earlier 2.5x) Sep’27E BVPS.

Core-operating performance remains strong despite transitory AQ challenges in NBFC Aptus’s core operating performance during Q2FY27 remains strong, despite asset quality challenges in NBFC – especially in less than INR0.7mn ticket-size segment – with RoE sustaining at 20% driven by robust 21% YoY AUM growth and sustainable ~20% RoE, with a 23% YoY NII growth offsetting the earnings impact of higher provisioning.
However, AQ stress persisted for the second consecutive quarter, as the 30+ DPD bucket increasing to 7.1% in Q2FY27, from 6.9% in Q1FY27 and 6.2% in Q4FY26.
